note: Every field below was read on the official MICHELIN Guide page, official restaurant site, or official booking page (Resy/Tock) shown in the same object. 'menu_price_usd' is the published per-person tasting/prix-fixe price (or verified deposit floor where price_is_floor is true); totals for two are doubled arithmetically. Null fields indicate values genuinely unpublished.

le-bernardin.exceptions: No lunch on Saturday or Sunday (Sat opens 17:00). Business casual; jacket/tie optional.
le-bernardin.price_note: Chef's Tasting Menu $350 pp ($530 pp w/ wine pairing); 4-course Prix Fixe Dinner $225 pp ($360 pp w/ wine pairing); 3-course Lunch $142 pp. Supplements: caviar $145/oz, Dover sole $28-$38, whole red snapper for two $25 pp.
le-bernardin.hours_note: Full week verified from MICHELIN structured hours block; building coordinates verified at 155 W 51st St (corrected from earlier Midtown West typo).

eleven-madison-park.exceptions: Fri-Sun 12:00-13:00 lunch seating window; non-refundable full payment at booking on Resy. Since Oct 2025 offers both 100% plant-based and optional animal-protein selections.
eleven-madison-park.price_note: Full Tasting Menu (6 courses) $385 pp ($770 for two); Bar Tasting Menu $255 pp ($510 for two); Lounge menu from $225 pp; wine pairings from $125 pp; corkage $75.
eleven-madison-park.booking_policy: Resy: payment in full at booking; sales final, no cancellations/rescheduling. Releases 1st of month prior at 09:00 EST.
eleven-madison-park.hours_note: Hours verified on MICHELIN Guide; menu tiers verified on elevenmadisonpark.com.

jungsik-new-york.exceptions: Dinner 7 days (Fri-Sun opens early at 15:00). Nearest 3-star venue to Arlo SoHo (0.64 km) and Residence Inn FiDi (1.30 km).
jungsik-new-york.price_note: Signature Tasting Menu $335 pp ($670 for two; $200 pp deposit at booking on Tock). Bar a la carte reservations require $50 pp deposit.
jungsik-new-york.hours_note: Hours and Signature Tasting price ($335 pp) verified from Tock booking page.

per-se.exceptions: Dinner only; 9-course Chef's Tasting Menu & Tasting of Vegetables. Salon offers shorter tasting/ALC options. Nearest 3-star venue to Fairfield Central Park (0.59 km).
per-se.price_note: Official Tock page: Main Dining Room Tasting Menu 'starting at $200 per person (deposit)'; Salon 'starting at $150 per person (deposit)'. Full tasting price is only displayed inside the live slot checkout flow.
per-se.hours_note: Daily 16:30-21:00 verified on MICHELIN Guide & Tock; full tasting price kept as deposit floor.

sushi-sho-1213976.booking: Tock (prepaid; releases 1st of month at 11:00 EST)
sushi-sho-1213976.exceptions: Intimate counter; prepaid non-refundable reservations open 1st of month at 11:00 EST (Feb 2027 seats release 1 Jan 2027).
sushi-sho-1213976.price_note: Tock listing: Shorter Omakase Course $495 pp inclusive of administrative fee ($990 for two before tax).
sushi-sho-1213976.hours_note: Hours verified on MICHELIN & sushi-sho.com; Tock price verified at $495 pp.

gabriel-kreuther.exceptions: No lunch Mon or Sat. Pre-Theatre 3-course menu $155 pp available for early seatings; Bar & Lounge offers lighter menu.
gabriel-kreuther.price_note: Official menu: Chef's Tasting Menu $325 pp ($650 for two); 4-Course $235 pp; 3-Course $200 pp; Pre-Theatre $155 pp. Wine pairings $255 classic / $595 reserve.
gabriel-kreuther.hours_note: Address, coordinates, full week hours, and four menu price tiers verified.

the-modern.address: 9 W. 53rd St. (inside MoMA), New York, NY 10019
the-modern.exceptions: Open 7 days including Sunday dinner; hospitality-included model or optional gratuity depending on room. Bar Room serves walk-ins and separate menu.
the-modern.price_note: Main Dining Room: Impressions Menu $185 pp ($370 for two); Abstractions Tasting $285 pp; Kitchen Table $345 pp. 3-Course Lunch $115 pp ($230 for two); Lunch Tasting $255 pp.
the-modern.hours_note: Inside MoMA; pairs directly with Wednesday MoMA visit on itinerary.

saga.address: 70 Pine St. (63rd Floor), New York, NY 10005
saga.exceptions: Open 7 nights including Sunday; 63rd-floor terrace views in FiDi (same landmark Art Deco building as 1-star Crown Shy). 4-minute walk from Residence Inn FiDi.
saga.price_note: 6-Course Tasting Menu $215 pp ($430 for two); 10-Course Tasting $315 pp ($630 for two); Kitchen Table $365 pp.
saga.hours_note: Daily hours and multi-tier tasting prices verified.

jean-georges.address: 1 Central Park West, New York, NY 10023
jean-georges.exceptions: Accessible menu pages state dinner starts 16:45, MICHELIN lists 17:00. Steps from Fairfield Central Park (Columbus Circle).
jean-georges.price_note: Six-Course Dinner Tasting $298 pp ($596 for two); Three-Course Lunch Tasting $128 pp ($256 for two).
jean-georges.hours_note: Hours and menu prices verified on accessible official site.

atomix.exceptions: Two distinct rooms: Bar Tasting Menu & Chef's Counter. Prepaid non-refundable release on the 1st of each month at 15:00 EST.
atomix.price_note: Tock listing (incl. administrative fee): Bar Tasting Menu from $314-$352+ pp ($628+ for two); Chef's Counter $424-$495 pp.
atomix.hours_note: Hours and prepaid Tock tiers verified.

atera.exceptions: Note: MICHELIN listing previously showed Mon-Sun hours while official Tock & ateranyc.com operate Tue-Sat only; confirm on Tock when booking.
atera.price_note: Tock states a $200 pp deposit at booking; total seasonal tasting price is displayed inside slot checkout.
atera.hours_note: Tribeca 18-seat chef's counter; Tock deposit floor verified.

aquavit.exceptions: Tock booking windows list 12:00-13:30 lunch / 17:30-21:00 dinner last seating. Formal Dining Room & casual Bar Room.
aquavit.price_note: Tock charges a $50 pp deposit for Dining Room Dinner (5-Course & Chef's Tasting) and $25 pp for Lunch/Bar Room. Full tasting price unpublished on overview page.
aquavit.hours_note: Full week hours verified on MICHELIN Guide page; Tock deposits verified.

daniel.exceptions: Holds 1 MICHELIN Star (2025). Open Sunday evenings (closed Monday — corrected from earlier entry). Jackets recommended.
daniel.price_note: Official menu: 3-Course Prix Fixe $195 pp ($390 for two); 5-Course Tasting $255 pp ($510 for two); Sommelier Wine Pairing $195 pp.
daniel.hours_note: Hours, Monday closure, updated prix-fixe URL and $195/$255 menu verified.

gramercy-tavern.exceptions: Two rooms with distinct hours & pricing: Dining Room seasonal tasting dinner shown above; walk-in front Tavern room serves a la carte 11:30-23:00 daily (hospitality-included).
gramercy-tavern.price_note: Dining Room Seasonal Dinner Tasting $178 pp ($356 for two); Wine Pairing $118 pp; Lunch 3-Course $78 pp ($156 for two); Tavern ALC mains $35-$45.
gramercy-tavern.hours_note: Both Dining Room & Tavern menus and hours verified on gramercytavern.com (F-10 explained).

le-coucou.exceptions: Inside 11 Howard Hotel; open 7 days for lunch and dinner.
le-coucou.price_note: 'Very Coucou' Tasting Menu $220 pp ($440 for two) or classic French a la carte; Lunch prix fixe $81 / $125 / $150 pp.
le-coucou.hours_note: Full week hours verified on MICHELIN; lunch & tasting pricing verified.

dirt-candy.booking: Resy (releases 30 days ahead at midnight EST)
dirt-candy.exceptions: 1 MICHELIN Star + MICHELIN Green Star. 100% vegetarian/vegan vegetable tasting; NO TIPPING (hospitality included in menu price).

dirt-candy.hours_note: Best-value fixed tasting menu among NYC Green Starred venues.

cote.exceptions: Open 7 nights (late dinner Thu-Sat until midnight). Butcher's Feast requires 2+ guests.
cote.price_note: Butcher's Feast (4 cuts USDA Prime & American Wagyu + full Korean accompaniments) $84 pp ($168 for two; +$32 A5 Wagyu supp). Steak Omakase $225 pp; wine pairing $110 pp.
cote.hours_note: Lowest fixed-menu price of any 1-star Manhattan restaurant verified.

crown-shy.address: 70 Pine St. (Ground Floor), New York, NY 10005
crown-shy.exceptions: Open 7 nights (weekday lunch Mon-Fri). Featured in MICHELIN 'Least Expensive 1-Star NYC' guide (~$75/head ALC).

semma.exceptions: Named #1 NYC restaurant by NYT & in MICHELIN 'Least Expensive 1-Star NYC' guide (~$75/head ALC). Very high demand on SevenRooms.

semma.hours_note: Full week hours and coordinates verified from MICHELIN Guide.
